simulator.note: Boots as the M3329 family (chips/m3329.py, chip ID 0x3101) from its 2 MB parallel NOR flash at 0xAFC00000: the bootloader (1.1.1, "APP  init ok") unpacks maincode(AV) into SDRAM and starts it ("APP  init ok", "main emu init", "TPSKeyDB Initing... 0", "max_key_db_count = 389").  PAN_COMMON_0 multiplexes its 4-digit 7-segment front panel through a 74HC164 shift register on CLK = GPIO 16, DATA = GPIO 17 and active-low digit strobes GPIO 18..21 (hc164_decoder.py: " ON " -> "----"), while OSD_M3327_0 renders its 58-colour 720x576 8 bpp CLUT direct framebuffer (0xB80041A0 = 0x0000800F, 0xB80041A4 = 0x805AC060, 0xB80041A8 = 0x02D00240) showing the "Information - No program found!" dialog.

desc: 2 MB Macronix MX29LV160B parallel-NOR JTAG flash dump (maincode dated 2007-10-14) from a BigSat DSR 6500 Lux DVB-S satellite receiver.

Pairs the older direct-framebuffer OSD_M3327 driver (0xB80041A8 window pitch/height register, rather than OSD_M3327C's 16-byte region-header linked list) with ALi's timer-multiplexed 74HC164 shift-register front panel (PAN_COMMON_0 on GPIO 16..21).
